title: Classify European descriptor bank zero
changes: Document conditional source evidence for descriptor pointer0 and bank0 records 1 through 15 while keeping record0 and arbitrary guest indices separate.
validation: Authenticated original Wine producer, initializer and caller windows, exact EUR source hashes and e98 ownership; checked 62 retained snapshots without a matching slot or predicate witness.
limitations: The initializer path and record reads are conditional source evidence rather than observed ordinary use; model, runtime, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
